soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1 and Theorem 1
soundness_flags.one_line: The core never defines the finite input representation or decision semantics of Acc(Q,E;G), while both the normal-form question and FPT theorem quantify over it and require exact rejection equivalence.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2
soundness_flags.one_line: “Adequate READ actions,” the ordinary-design instance, and the cost-preserving embedding are not formally specified, so the asserted equivalence and resulting NP-hardness reduction have no determinate domain.

soundness_flags.label: ass:measured-ancestry
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited CTFIDU+ paper takes supplied Layer-3 distributions as inputs and does not state the bespoke READ-or-fixed measured-ancestry condition under the asserted standard name; retag it novel and justify its physical applicability.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 4–5, Algorithm 2 lines 1–15; p. 30, Lemma E.10
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Algorithm 2 accepts a graph, unnested query, and input-distribution specifications, then processes supplied factors; Lemma E.10 establishes an L2.5 ancestral/nonconflicting-potential-response property, not the proposal's READ-or-fixed measured-ancestry condition.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Theorem 3.5 and definition of maximal feasible action set, p. 6
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: CTF-REALIZE is stated correct and complete for realizability from a graph and available action set, with SELECT, READ, and CTF-RAND actions.
For a c-component target, a no-more-costly singleton intervention collection exists; minimum-cost intervention design is equivalent to weighted hitting set over hedges in the stated ordinary setting.
The journal extension studies minimum-cost ordinary intervention design, establishes NP-completeness, and uses hitting-set/set-cover formulations.
The paper reformulates minimum-cost proxy experiment design for more efficient computation and also studies valid-adjustment-set designs.

The paper proves counterfactual unnesting and gives a necessary-and-sufficient graphical condition plus a complete identification algorithm for nested counterfactuals from observational and experimental sources.

Positivity of the observational distribution is necessary for the repaired general-identifiability formulation, and the paper provides a sound-and-complete positivity-aware algorithm reducing to classical identification subproblems.
The paper extends MS properties to EMS counting and summing evaluations on fixed bounded-treewidth graph classes.
The paper introduces a counterfactual structural causal bandit framework with realizable counterfactual actions, rather than an acquisition-cost optimizer.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define Acc operationally as a polynomial-size encoded CTFIDU+ run over a specified finite collection of protocol-slice records, and state the exact encoding size of LIT, labels, and source collections used by the compilation.

Replace the informal ordinary subclass with a formal embedding map from every Akbari–Etesami–Kiyavash instance to a catalogue instance, including READ records, costs, and both directions of feasibility preservation.
Retag measured ancestry as a novel physical source-typing restriction, provide a concrete laboratory/platform regime satisfying it, and state precisely which arbitrary-partial-READ cases it excludes.
Add a worked nontrivial protocol instance showing the incidence structure, a uniform certificate, and preservation of its exact cost through the MSO interpretation.

recommended_next_step: Revise the operational semantics and embedding definitions, retag the bespoke source-typing restriction, then rerun novelty review; the coupled kernel remains field-tier plausible.
